panels.title: Downloading
panels.description: Torrents in qBittorrent that haven't finished downloading, including stalled and queued ones.

panels.title: To encode
panels.description: Video files in sorted-media, including the one being encoded.

panels.title: Encoded
panels.description: Progress of the current av1ator encode, by content position.

panels.title: Encode ETA
panels.description: Remaining content time divided by av1ator's current encode speed.

panels.title: Uploading
panels.description: rclone-move's current upload rate to jotta.

panels.title: Data disk used
panels.description: /var/mnt/data, which holds downloads and both staging dirs. healthchecks alerts at 90%.

panels.title: Collectors down
panels.description: media-metrics collectors that can't read their source, plus the exporter itself if VictoriaMetrics can't scrape it. The media-metrics journal names the cause.

panels.title: Torrents downloading
panels.description: Torrents qBittorrent hasn't finished. stalledDL means no peer is sending data. An availability below 1 means no connected peer has a complete copy.

targets.expr: max by (hash, name, state) (media_torrent_progress_ratio * on (hash) group_left (state) media_torrent_info)
max by (hash, name, state) (media_torrent_size_bytes * on (hash) group_left (state) media_torrent_info)
max by (hash, name, state) (media_torrent_left_bytes * on (hash) group_left (state) media_torrent_info)
max by (hash, name, state) (media_torrent_download_bytes_per_second * on (hash) group_left (state) media_torrent_info)
max by (hash, name, state) (media_torrent_eta_seconds * on (hash) group_left (state) media_torrent_info)
max by (hash, name, state) (media_torrent_availability * on (hash) group_left (state) media_torrent_info)
max by (hash, name, state) (media_torrent_seeds * on (hash) group_left (state) media_torrent_info)
max by (hash, name, state) (media_torrent_added_timestamp_seconds * on (hash) group_left (state) media_torrent_info * 1000)

panels.title: Current encode
panels.description: The file av1ator is working on. A passthrough copies a file the filters exclude, such as one wider than 1920, and has no progress.

panels.title: Waiting in sorted-media
panels.description: Video files filebot has sorted, waiting for av1ator. Waiting is the time since the file arrived here.

panels.title: Skipped by av1ator
panels.description: Files av1ator has given up on until it restarts. They stay in sorted-media.

panels.title: Encode speed
panels.description: Encoded content time per wall-clock time. 0.1x means an hour of video takes 10 hours.

panels.title: Uploading
panels.description: Files rclone-move is uploading to jotta now.

panels.title: Waiting in plex-media
panels.description: Encoded files waiting for rclone-move. It uploads a file once its size is unchanged for two 30 s scans.

panels.title: Last upload
panels.description: When rclone-move's last move finished. Red if it failed.

panels.title: Recently added
panels.description: The 20 newest movies or episodes in each Plex section.

panels.title: Files waiting
panels.description: Video files in each staging dir.

panels.title: Download and upload
panels.description: qBittorrent's total download rate and rclone-move's upload rate.

panels.title: Disk used
panels.description: Used share of each disk.

panels.title: CPU
panels.description: Share of CPU time not idle, across all cores. av1ator runs at nice 10.

panels.title: Memory
panels.description: Memory in use, excluding reclaimable cache.
